reason: Both catch the same core four defects (LEFT JOIN turned into INNER JOIN, UTC offset ignored, integer division truncation, NULL total for zero-order customers) with essentially equal accuracy and clarity, but B's fifth point — that NULL totals will sort to the top of the DESC ranking, defeating the report's purpose — is a concrete, directly-verifiable consequence of the actual ORDER BY clause in the query, whereas A's fifth point (GROUP BY strict-mode portability) is a speculative edge case that A itself concedes usually isn't an actual bug on the databases in question.
